evidence: Modifies test/functional/p2p_opportunistic_1p1c.py to properly exercise orphan pool limit saturation and DoS eviction logic.
rationale: Fixes a vacuous P2P functional test so that it actually exercises orphan pool eviction. Previously, duplicate orphan transactions via tx messages were dropped without recording peer IDs, leaving the orphanage at 152 announcements against a 3000 limit, which allowed broken eviction logic to pass undetected.
